data.name: Pirate's Jargon
data.description: The buccaneer's baffling palaver of nautical jargon and piratical cant provides a +2 bonus on Bluff and Intimidate checks. Furthermore, she can spend a swift action and 1 grit point to cause a single living creature within 30 feet to make a Will saving throw (DC = %1) or become confused for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting language dependent effect.|10+Gunslinger/2+CHA
